object.name: TrackingData
object.description: Latest object tracking result received from the companion computer by the @ref VisionTracker module.

field.name: X
field.description: bbox center, -1 left edge .. 1 right edge

field.name: Y
field.description: bbox center, -1 top edge .. 1 bottom edge

field.name: Width
field.description: bbox width relative to the image width

field.name: Height
field.description: bbox height relative to the image height

field.name: RxErrors
field.description: frames dropped because of a CRC or length error
